94	     * 任何不满足条件的情形返回 [Result.Rejected]，不抛异常、不产生读数。
95	     */
96	    fun decodeAggregatedFrame(frame: ByteArray): Result {
97	        if (frame.size < HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE) {
98	            return Result.Rejected(
99	                RejectionReason.FRAME_TOO_SHORT,
100	                "plain=${frame.size}B < header=${HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE}B"
101	            )
102	        }
103	
104	        val devCount = frame[6].toInt() and 0xFF
105	        if (devCount == 0) {
106	            return Result.Rejected(
107	                RejectionReason.NO_DEVICE,
108	                "devCount=0"
109	            )
110	        }
111	
112	        val expected = expectedFrameSize(devCount)
113	        if (frame.size < expected) {
114	            return Result.Rejected(
115	                RejectionReason.LENGTH_MISMATCH,
116	                "plain=${frame.size}B < expected=${expected}B (devCount=$devCount)"
117	            )
118	        }
119	
120	        val gatewayIdHex = toColonHex(frame.copyOfRange(0, 6))
121	        val samples = ArrayList<SensorSample>(devCount)
122	        var off = HEADER_BLOCK_SIZE
123	        repeat(devCount) {
124	            samples += decodeDeviceBlock(frame, off)
125	            off += DEVICE_BLOCK_SIZE
126	        }
127	        return Result.Success(gatewayIdHex, devCount, samples)
128	    }
129	
130	    /**
131	     * 解码单个设备块（16 B，仅前 8 B 有效）。
132	     * 供需要按块复用的调用方使用；不改变字段偏移与换算。
133	     */
134	    fun decodeDeviceBlock(block: ByteArray, offset: Int): SensorSample {
135	        val p8 = block.copyOfRange(offset, offset + DEVICE_PAYLOAD_SIZE)
136	        val devIdBytes = p8.copyOfRange(0, 4)
137	        val humi = u16be(p8, 4) / 10.0
138	        val temp = s16be(p8, 6) / 10.0
139	        return SensorSample(
140	            devIdBytes = devIdBytes,
141	            devIdHex = toColonHex(devIdBytes),
142	            devIdCompact = toCompactHex(devIdBytes),
143	            humidityPct = humi,
144	            temperatureC = temp
145	        )
146	    }
147	}
